2. Masking: Use QA_PIXEL to mask clouds, cloud shadows, snow, dilated clouds, and radiometric saturation. Compute median NDVI composites.
3. Validity: Check collection sizes (C1), valid pixel counts after masking (C2), and ensure NDVI means are finite and within [-1,1] (C3). Deforestation if baseline NDVI ≥ 0.6, target NDVI ≤ 0.5, and drop ≥ 0.15.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    // Input longitude had a formatting issue; using the plausible corrected value within WV.
    const lat = 38.07594286088219;
    const lon = -81.97068176434179;
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]);
    const roi = pt.buffer(1500); // 1.5 km buffer to safely use 1000 m scale reducers

    const baselineStart = '1984-06-01';
    const baselineEnd = '1985-10-31';
    const targetStart = '2008-04-01';
    const targetEnd = '2009-06-02';

    // 2. Helpers
    const getInfoAsync = (eeObj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo((res, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(res))));

    function maskScaleNdviL2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const dilatedClear = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0);
      const cloudClear = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0);
      const shadowClear = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0);
      const snowClear = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0);
      const waterClear = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 7).eq(0);
      const radsatClear = img.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0);
      const mask = dilatedClear.and(cloudClear).and(shadowClear).and(snowClear).and(waterClear).and(radsatClear);

      const sr = img.select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B4']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const ndvi = sr.select('SR_B4')
        .subtract(sr.select('SR_B3'))
        .divide(sr.select('SR_B4').add(sr.select('SR_B3')))
        .rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start', 'CLOUD_COVER']);
    }

    async function chooseCollection(primaryId, fallbackId, start, end, geometry) {
      const primary = ee.ImageCollection(primaryId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geometry);
      const primarySize = await getInfoAsync(primary.size());
      if (primarySize > 0) {
        return { col: primary, id: primaryIdShort(primaryId), size: primarySize };
      }
      if (fallbackId) {
        const fallback = ee.ImageCollection(fallbackId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geometry);
        const fallbackSize = await getInfoAsync(fallback.size());
        if (fallbackSize > 0) {
          return { col: fallback, id: primaryIdShort(fallbackId), size: fallbackSize };
        }
      }
      return { col: null, id: null, size: 0 };
    }

    function primaryIdShort(id) {
      const parts = id.split('/');
      return parts[1] || id;
    }

    async function compositeStats(col, geometry) {
      const ndviCol = col.map(maskScaleNdviL2);
      const composite = ndviCol.median();
      const countDict = composite.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geometry,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      const meanDict = composite.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geometry,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      const validPixels = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('NDVI'));
      const meanNdvi = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('NDVI'));
      const cloudMean = await getInfoAsync(ndviCol.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER'));
      return { composite, validPixels: validPixels || 0, meanNdvi, cloudMean };
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Checks
    const baseChoice = await chooseCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2', baselineStart, baselineEnd, roi);
    const targChoice = await chooseCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', targetStart, targetEnd, roi);

    if (!baseChoice.col || !targChoice.col) {
      console.log(`Point used: ${lat.toFixed(5)}, ${lon.toFixed(5)} (1.5km buf)`);
      console.log(`Baseline window: ${baselineStart} to ${baselineEnd}; Images: ${baseChoice.size}`);
      console.log(`Target window: ${targetStart} to ${targetEnd}; Images: ${targChoice.size}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const baseStats = await compositeStats(baseChoice.col, roi);
    const targStats = await compositeStats(targChoice.col, roi);

    // 4. Valid Pixel Checks
    console.log(`Point used: ${lat.toFixed(5)}, ${lon.toFixed(5)} (1.5km buf)`);
    console.log(`Baseline: ${baselineStart} to ${baselineEnd} | ${baseChoice.id} imgs: ${baseChoice.size} | cloud%: ${baseStats.cloudMean !== null ? baseStats.cloudMean.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Baseline NDVI mean: ${baseStats.meanNdvi !== null ? baseStats.meanNdvi.toFixed(3) : 'null'} | valid px: ${baseStats.validPixels}`);

    console.log(`Target: ${targetStart} to ${targetEnd} | ${targChoice.id} imgs: ${targChoice.size} | cloud%: ${targStats.cloudMean !== null ? targStats.cloudMean.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Target NDVI mean: ${targStats.meanNdvi !== null ? targStats.meanNdvi.toFixed(3) : 'null'} | valid px: ${targStats.validPixels}`);

    if (baseStats.validPixels === 0 || targStats.validPixels === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation, Validation & Final Answer
    const bMean = baseStats.meanNdvi;
    const tMean = targStats.meanNdvi;
    if (bMean === null || tMean === null || !isFinite(bMean) || !isFinite(tMean) || bMean < -1 || bMean > 1 || tMean < -1 || tMean > 1) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const delta = tMean - bMean;
    console.log(`Delta NDVI: ${delta.toFixed(3)}`);

    // Deforestation criteria: strong forest baseline, clear drop to non-forest
    const deforested = (bMean >= 0.60) && (tMean <= 0.50) && (delta <= -0.15);

    console.log(deforested ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    // Unexpected error (e.g., dataset/band name, memory, etc.)
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
